ndfec30c5ec.headline: IEA chief warns of ‘largest energy crisis in history’
ndfec30c5ec.summary: IEA chief Fatih Birol warns the world faces its biggest energy crisis, driven by war tensions and supply disruptions.
ndfec30c5ec.why: The International Energy Agency advises major oil-consuming governments on energy security and publishes global supply and demand outlooks.

ne8563a142f.headline: 'Tiny' tax returns on gas has leading economist fuming
ne8563a142f.summary: An Australian economist says returns on the country's finite gas and other natural resources are too small, arguing Australians deserve a fair return on them.
ne8563a142f.why: Resource taxation and royalty settings shape government revenue and the investment economics of gas producers.

nad2edabeaa.headline: Hatzidakis: Greece's positions on the new CAP - EU likely to decide on 2028-2034 budget during Greece's presidency
nad2edabeaa.summary: Greek official Hatzidakis set out Greece's positions on the new Common Agricultural Policy for 2028-2034, which is not limited to direct payments. The EU is likely to decide on the budget during Greece's presidency.
nad2edabeaa.why: The Common Agricultural Policy is the EU's largest budget line, shaping farm incomes and food-sector investment across member states.

nd230e7f6cd.headline: Energy bills to drop
nd230e7f6cd.summary: Energy bills could fall for millions of UK households under new government plans. The report did not specify the size or timing of the reduction.
nd230e7f6cd.why: Household energy bills in the UK are set by the regulator Ofgem and drive consumer spending power and inflation expectations.

nb82e2380db.headline: Crest Nicholson warns over profits amid Iran war impact on costs and demand
nb82e2380db.summary: UK housebuilder Crest Nicholson warned on profits as the Iran war affects costs and demand. It said it has seen a slowdown in new inquiries and visitor levels since its last update in March.
nb82e2380db.why: Crest Nicholson is a UK homebuilder, and its trading updates indicate conditions in the UK housing market and construction costs.
nb82e2380db.why_moved: The profit warning cites rising costs from the Iran war and a slowdown in new inquiries and visitor levels since March.

n7a9ede16ff.headline: ASX 200 Today: Support Firming Up As Index Closes Almost Flat. Plenty of Movement Under The Hood - The Bull
n7a9ede16ff.summary: The ASX 200 closed down 0.04% at 8,949.40 after testing support near 8,900. Defence technology stocks rallied while high-valuation growth names faced profit-taking.
n7a9ede16ff.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, and its moves reflect the local equity market.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

sources.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

n409ce52808.headline: Borschahivsky Chemical Pharmaceutical Plant seeks to recover UAH 50.7 mln from Russia over destruction of warehouse in 2025 shelling
n409ce52808.summary: PJSC Borschahivsky Chemical Pharmaceutical Plant is seeking to recover UAH 50.7 million in damages from Russia. The claim covers destruction of its property in a missile strike on July 31, 2025.
n409ce52808.why: Borschahivsky is a Ukrainian pharmaceutical manufacturer, and war-damage claims affect the recovery prospects of Ukrainian companies and the wider reconstruction economy.

n4575b861bc.headline: As Iran crisis drags on, fears of global food catastrophe grow
n4575b861bc.summary: Global food prices have risen modestly so far, but analysts say the full impact of the Iran conflict has yet to be felt. Fears of a global food catastrophe are growing.
n4575b861bc.why: Food prices depend on energy, fertiliser and shipping costs, so Middle East conflict can feed through to agricultural commodities and inflation worldwide.

n0131118bb5.headline: SK Hynix Shares Powers South Korea’s KOSPI to Record High - The Bull
n0131118bb5.summary: South Korea's KOSPI rose 2.72% to an all-time closing high of 6,388.47 on Tuesday. Semiconductor stocks led the rally, with SK Hynix among the technology heavyweights driving gains.
n0131118bb5.why: SK Hynix is a leading memory chip maker, and the KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductors.

n81b6209f0f.headline: Here are 3 takeaways as Trump's pick to lead the Fed faces a confirmation fight
n81b6209f0f.summary: Kevin Warsh, Trump's pick to lead the Federal Reserve, appeared before a Senate committee. His confirmation could be held up by factors outside his control.
n81b6209f0f.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates and influences the dollar and Treasury yields. Its leadership changes can shift expectations for monetary policy.

nc59ce95262.headline: Higher than expected inflation raises odds of May OCR hike
nc59ce95262.summary: Higher-than-expected New Zealand inflation has raised the odds of a May official cash rate hike. Fuel prices were the biggest driver of quarterly inflation.
nc59ce95262.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, which anchors borrowing costs and the New Zealand dollar. Inflation data is central to its decisions.
nc59ce95262.why_moved: Inflation came in above expectations, with fuel prices the main driver, increasing the likelihood of a May policy tightening.

nedf555c7ab.headline: Pressure to increase tax on gas exports
nedf555c7ab.summary: As Australia's fuel crisis continues, pressure is growing on the federal government to ensure Australians receive more revenue from gas exports.
nedf555c7ab.why: Australia is one of the world's largest LNG exporters, so changes to export taxation affect government revenue and gas-sector profits.

n6dee0d68c0.headline: Rupee plunges 32 paise to  settle at 93.48 against US dollar
n6dee0d68c0.summary: The rupee closed 32 paise lower at 93.48 per US dollar, provisionally, on Tuesday. The move reflected a steady American currency and volatile crude oil prices amid uncertainty over West Asia peace progress.
n6dee0d68c0.why: The Indian rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, particularly for oil, and is closely watched by foreign investors in Indian assets.
n6dee0d68c0.why_moved: A steady US dollar and volatile crude oil prices, amid uncertainty over West Asia peace progress, weighed on the rupee.

n2e51606e67.headline: HYBE Chairman Bang Si-hyuk faces arrest warrant in USD 136 million allegations of misleading IPO investors - Reports | English Movie News
n2e51606e67.summary: South Korean police have moved to arrest HYBE chairman Bang Si-hyuk as they widen an investigation into alleged investor fraud linked to the company's IPO, reportedly involving USD 136 million.
n2e51606e67.why: HYBE is a major South Korean entertainment company, and governance or fraud allegations can affect its share price and investor confidence.

n4b9163b776.headline: Rebound expected in home sales to foreign buyers: Survey - Latest News
n4b9163b776.summary: A housing sector expectations survey by KONUTDER and NielsenIQ Türkiye indicates that a renewed rise in home sales to foreign buyers is beginning to emerge.
n4b9163b776.why: Foreign buyer demand for Turkish property is a channel for foreign currency inflows and affects the construction and real estate sector.

n26f95d36a4.headline: ‘Largest Singapore commercial S-Reit proxy’: analysts say buy CICT shares after Paragon acquisition
n26f95d36a4.summary: Analysts say CICT's acquisition of the Paragon mall cements its position as the largest Singapore commercial S-REIT. The deal strengthens its dominance in Singapore's retail space.
n26f95d36a4.why: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust is a Singapore-listed real estate investment trust owning retail and office properties.

n77b5662ef6.headline: Retail Sales Rise, Majority Spent At Gas Pump Amid High Prices
n77b5662ef6.summary: US retail spending increased from February to March, but most of the growth was spent at gas pumps amid high prices. The input does not give the size of the increase.
n77b5662ef6.why: Retail sales are a key monthly gauge of US consumer spending, which drives a large share of economic growth.

n0be8d7a1dd.headline: Apple switches CEO: What it means for the tech giant
n0be8d7a1dd.summary: Apple's top hardware engineer John Ternus will lead the $4 trillion iPhone maker as Tim Cook steps back. Analysts question whether Apple will chase rivals in intelligence or focus on personal AI experience.
n0be8d7a1dd.why: Apple is one of the world's largest companies by market value, and its leadership and product strategy strongly influence global technology stocks and the smartphone market.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: The leadership change at Apple directly concerns its future strategy and management.

n0be8d7a1dd.why_moved: A change of chief executive at a company of Apple's size raises questions about its direction, particularly in artificial intelligence.

n5ed57a8a03.headline: Lucid Group shares jump after Uber investment, fresh capital inflows fuel takeover speculation
n5ed57a8a03.summary: Lucid Group shares rose 10.3% on Tuesday morning after a series of capital deals, including an Uber investment. Attention has also turned to takeover speculation.
n5ed57a8a03.why: Lucid is an electric vehicle maker based in the United States, and its funding and partnerships affect investor views on the EV sector.

impacts.why: Shares rose after capital deals and an Uber investment were reported.

n5ed57a8a03.why_moved: Fresh investment from Uber and other capital inflows, along with takeover speculation, drew buyers into the stock.

nd9612cc4ac.headline: OUE Reit posts 8.4% rise in Q1 NPI to S$57.6 million
nd9612cc4ac.summary: OUE REIT's net property income rose 8.4% in the first quarter to S$57.6 million. The increase reflected stronger contributions from its commercial and hospitality segments.
nd9612cc4ac.why: OUE REIT is a Singapore-listed real estate investment trust with office, retail and hotel assets, so its income reflects Singapore property demand.

n640c6cd129.headline: China lifts lending caps for foreign banks | IFR
n640c6cd129.summary: China has lifted lending caps for foreign banks. The loosened limits aim to support China Inc's overseas expansion.
n640c6cd129.why: Lending rules for foreign banks in China shape cross-border credit flows and the competitive position of international lenders in the Chinese market.

n276dd272c5.headline: China cuts petrol, diesel price caps for first time since start of Iran war
n276dd272c5.summary: China has reduced its petrol and diesel price caps for the first time since the start of the Iran war, as global oil prices retreat from their peaks during the conflict.
n276dd272c5.why: China's fuel price caps set domestic pump prices, so changes pass through to inflation and consumer spending.

ne6671d844e.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0, Codex Labs developer training service
ne6671d844e.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.0 and a Codex Labs developer training service, expanding its suite of AI tools.
ne6671d844e.why: OpenAI develops ChatGPT and related AI models, and its product launches shape competition in the generative AI market.

nede96150b4.headline: Trancom and ANA Launch Cold-Chain Air-Ground Service to Ease Japan Logistics Crunch
nede96150b4.summary: Trancom and ANA will launch the Sorapare Cool service from April 22, using insulated boxes on standard trucks for same-day cold-chain delivery via 10 domestic airports. It responds to Japan's truck driver shortage.
nede96150b4.why: ANA is a major Japanese airline, and logistics capacity affects delivery costs and supply chains for perishable goods.

n3da7a46d12.headline: Indonesia plans electric trains on three major lines for efficiency
n3da7a46d12.summary: Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprises Regulatory Agency announced plans to accelerate the energy transition in public transport through electric trains on three major lines.
n3da7a46d12.why: Rail electrification projects in Indonesia involve state-owned enterprises and infrastructure contractors, affecting public spending and energy demand.

nb8717fc88a.headline: 'Tiny' tax returns on gas has leading economist fuming
nb8717fc88a.summary: An economist argues Australians deserve a fair return on finite gas and other natural resources, criticising the current tax take as too small.
nb8717fc88a.why: Resource taxation and royalties determine how much government revenue and investor return come from gas projects, affecting project economics and policy risk.

n4c93bd299b.headline: Daikin, GridShare Japan launch AI service to optimize solar-powered water heating
n4c93bd299b.summary: Daikin and GridShare Japan launched a service linking Daikin's Eco Cute remote-control platform with GridShare's AI to shift water heating toward surplus solar power.
n4c93bd299b.why: Daikin is a major Japanese maker of air conditioning and heat pump systems, so new energy-management services affect its household product business.

n46e738777a.headline: Malaysia consumes 700,000 barrels of oil a day, twice its daily production, so importing still needed - MoF - paultan.org
n46e738777a.summary: Malaysia consumes 700,000 barrels of oil a day, twice its daily production, so imports are still needed, according to the finance ministry amid the global fuel crisis.
n46e738777a.why: Net oil importers are exposed to global crude price swings, and domestic fuel subsidies and supply policy affect government finances.

n29288c23d9.headline: Taiwan could allow cash dividends in foreign currencies from 2027: Regulator - Taipei Times
n29288c23d9.summary: Taiwan's regulator said cash dividends could be paid in foreign currencies from 2027. The candidate gives no further details on scope or conditions.
n29288c23d9.why: Taiwan hosts major listed technology companies with large foreign shareholder bases. Changes to dividend payment rules affect how overseas investors receive returns and handle currency exposure.
